blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Wednesday, Nov. 18, reminded motorists that security exclusion zones and other traffic schemes implemented for the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summit remain in effect. In an advisory, the MMDA said that it continues to strictly implement restrictions around the Cultural Center of the Philippines complex, Philippine International Convention Center, and other key areas used for the regional gathering. The agency said the move is to ensure safe and smooth travel for foreign delegates as the 49th Asean Summit formally ended on Tuesday. Among the foreign leaders scheduled to leave the […]...
